status: Initial whole-source visual triage complete; visual treatment remains incomplete. Retain-current decisions are provisional sample judgments, not linguistic or all-glyph approval.
scope: 199 source files / 381 packaged shards; one selected native-owned sample per source, at 22 and 44 px beside Dad. Browser screenshots on all 17 atlas pages inspected. Page 1 was reviewed in the preceding goal turn; pages 2–17 in this turn. No font load errors.
limitations: Samples do not prove every character is correctly drawn or every sentence linguistically correct.
Initial atlas fixed rows obscured tall/stacked glyphs; layout now reserves actual ink bounds. Khitan page rechecked after repair.
Many supplemental samples are sparse glyph studies, not linguistic sentences.
The review is triage for implementation, not a blanket acceptance of native source fonts as finished custom lettering.
next: Prototype smooth pen pressure/contour variation on supplemental typeset forms. Preserve native joining, marks, source provenance, and semantic distinctions. Compare actual strips before integrating.
